services.name: Interaction_SynchronizeResponseState
behavior: Drains ACTOR_RESPONSE_COUNTER through the unthrottled response-counter helper.
Copies the six-byte pending response state to the published state when it has not passed the current value.

services.name: Interaction_DrainResponseCounter
behavior: Decrements ACTOR_RESPONSE_COUNTER without the even-frame gate used by Interaction_UpdateCounter.
Invokes the response reset helper after the configured response budget.

conclusion: The interaction response counter has a frame-throttled gameplay updater and an unthrottled drain used by the response-state synchronization path.
